summary: Iteration 2 validation: Style Profiles CRUD + cross-user scoping, Cloud Jobs full lifecycle (queued→processing→completed with polling, download 409 before completion, ZIP contents, cross-user 404, empty filenames 400, auth required), and frontend ProcessingPage e2e (session cookie login → /processing?project=ID → cloud-job-panel + cloud-progress render → cloud-download-btn triggers real ZIP download containing one .xmp per filename + LEEME.txt → back-dashboard-btn returns to /dashboard). All 15 backend pytest tests pass (9 iteration-1 regression + 6 iteration-2). Dashboard regression also verified reachable with session cookie.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py run_cloud_job: no try/except around DB updates — if the asyncio task raises (network blip, Mongo timeout), the job stays stuck in 'processing' forever with no failure marker. Wrap the loop and mark status='failed' on exception; also expose the error via GET /cloud-jobs/{id}.

server.py create_cloud_job uses asyncio.create_task without keeping a strong reference — Python may GC the task mid-run (see https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#asyncio.create_task 'save a reference to the result'). Store tasks in a module-level set and discard on done_callback.

server.py PATCH /projects/{id}/state performs an in-Python read-modify-write on rawai_state — not atomic; concurrent PATCHes can lose writes. Use $set with dot-notation keys, or a $mergeObjects aggregation update.

server.py CloudJob download builds ZIP entirely in memory (build_zip returns BytesIO) — fine for MVP (a few hundred XMPs), but for large weddings (2000+ RAWs @ ~2KB each ≈ 4MB) still ok; just noting no streaming.
server.py build_xmp exposure formatting inconsistency persists from iteration 1 (exposure uses '+.2f', all others int(round)). Consider a unified formatter dict.
ProcessingPage.jsx swallows API errors with bare `catch { navigate('/dashboard') }` — a real backend outage silently redirects the user with no toast. Show a toast on failure so the user knows why.
ProcessingPage.jsx polling has no max-attempts / no exponential backoff — a stuck job polls forever every 1.5s. Add a timeout / 'failed' state handling once run_cloud_job supports failure.
CORS_ORIGINS still '*' with allow_credentials=True — iteration-1 finding still open.
test_credentials: Session-based Emergent Google Auth. Two ephemeral test users seeded per-run in test_database.users + test_database.user_sessions (fixtures auto-cleanup). Third UI user seeded manually + cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: For UI test: seeded 1 user, 1 session, 1 project (rawai_state.cloudJobId set), 1 completed cloud_job with 3 filenames in test_database — all cleaned up after run. Pytest fixtures self-clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/` (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, seeds+cleans users). Iteration 2 coverage in test_iteration2.py. For UI: seed a project with rawai_state.cloudJobId + a completed cloud_jobs doc, set session_token cookie, navigate to /processing?project=ID — data-testids used: cloud-job-panel, cloud-progress, cloud-download-btn, back-dashboard-btn. Studio inner steps (SelectionStep, ReviewStep thumbnails, PresetParamsStep xmp upload, ProcessingModeChoice mode-local-btn/mode-cloud-btn) still require webkitdirectory folder selection which Playwright cannot populate headlessly — environment limitation, not a bug. If needed, seed rawai_state.selectedFiles + reviewed frames directly to exercise later steps.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the requested iteration-2 scope.
